finalText:
Found the leak. The `processOrder` function was acquiring a connection but not releasing it when the order failed validation. Unlike the safe `handleRequest` wrapper above it, it had no try/finally—so when `run()` threw an error, the connection never made it back to the pool.

Fixed it by wrapping the await in try/finally, matching the pattern in `withConnection`. All 4 tests pass now, including the one that explicitly checks for this scenario. Your pool will recover cleanly from validation failures instead of exhausting under load.
